name: A Perfect Couple
source:
A Perfect Couple, is a phone-texting game where you communicate with your beautiful wife Emily and others through your phone. The story begins with Brian (The husband) arriving in Egypt for what was supposed to be a short trip, only for work to extend his stay to a full year. 

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/naughtynarrative/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
A Perfect Couple, is a phone-texting game where you communicate with your beautiful wife Emily and others through your phone. The story begins with Brian (The husband) arriving in Egypt for what was supposed to be a short trip, only for work to extend his stay to a full year. 

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/naughtynarrative/about]Patreon[/url]]
